name: generate_rfq_confirmation
description: Generate a well-structured RFQ confirmation message with summary and outstanding questions

summary.description:
A clear, bullet-pointed summary of the RFQ details collected so far. Format as:
• Products: [quantity] pcs of [product name] (Brand: [brand name if available]) + additional products if multiple
• Delivery Location: [city, state, pincode]
• Delivery Date: [date]
• Remarks: [any specifications or remarks if available]
For delivery date, use delivery_date_display if available (formatted as 'DD Month YYYY'), otherwise use delivery_date. IMPORTANT: If brand, remarks, or other optional fields are provided, include them in the summary. Include only the information that has been collected.

confirmation_request.description: A friendly request asking the user to confirm or make changes. Keep it natural and encouraging.
